newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL WANT TO AVOID COMPLICATIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL WANT TO AVOID COMPLICATIONS.

text.p: Portugal go into Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Ukraine knowing that anything but a win could jeopardise their chances of reaching the 1998 finals in France.
"We must win or things are going to get very complicated," said coach Artur Jorge.

After impressing in the European championships last summer, the talented but inconsistent Portuguese have just one victory in three games in their campaign to reach the finals for only the third time.
With Germany also in qualifying group nine, the Portuguese need maximum points against the Ukrainians after losing the away leg 2-1 a month ago.

Ukraine, who head the group with a maximum six points from two games, will be boosted by the return of midfielder Hennady Orbu whose Russian club Rotor Volgograd had refused to release him for the home game.
Portugal are second with four points, one more than Germany. But the Germans have only played once.
"It is going to be difficult. From now on, there are no easy games but we are optimistic and convinced that we can put on a good display," Jorge said.
The coach, who took over from Antonio Oliveira after Euro 96 has the comfort of no major selection problems.
The Barcelona trio -- goalkeeper Vitor Baia, defender Fernando Couto and attacking midfielder Luis Figo -- are all fit and have been in good form recently with the Spanish league leaders.

The only question appears to surround veteran Joao Pinto, with 69 appearances the most capped Portuguese player still active. He could make a return to the national team after an absence of 18 months.
Portugal (probable) - Vitor Baia, Joao Pinto, Helder Cristovao, Fernando Couto, Dimas Teixeira, Jorge Costa or Paulo Bento, Oceano Cruz, Ricardo Sa Pinto, Luis Figo, Rui Costa, Joao Vieira Pinto
Ukraine (squad) - Goalkeepers: Oleh Suslov, Olexander Shovkovsky, Illya Blyznyuk.
Defenders: Oleh Luzhny, Yuri Dmytrulin, Serhiy Bezhenar, Olexander Holovko, Vladyslav Vashchuk, Dmytro Parfyonov, Viktor Skrypnyk, Serhiy Popov.
Midfielders: Yuri Maksimov, Yuri Kalitvintsev, Vitaly Kosovsky, Vasyl Kardash, Serhiy Yesin, Valery Kryventsov, Hennady Zubov, Hennady Orbu, Serhiy Kovalets.
Forwards: Viktor Leonenko, Serhiy Rebrov, Andriy Shevchenko, Timerlan Guseinov.
